DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日のご出発に向けて、何かお確かめになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check before your departure tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝の集合に遅れないよう、携帯の起床予定を作りました。ただ、母国にいた時の時刻のままのようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 翌朝の起床予定が母国時刻のままらしく集合に遅れないため確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've set a wake-up alarm so I won't be late for the morning meeting. But it seems to still be using the time in my home country.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that tomorrow morning's wake-up alarm seems to use your home country's time and you want to check it to avoid being late for the meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 集合の案内には、こちらの時刻で書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the meeting information written in local time?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、案内は日本の時刻です。携帯の表示と同じだと思い、数字だけ見て設定していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日本時刻の集合案内を携帯と数字だけで一致と考えたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the information uses Japan time. I thought it matched the phone display and set it just by looking at the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you assumed the Japan-time meeting information matched your phone just by comparing the numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: いまの時刻は、こちらの時計でも確かめられます。端末の設定は、ご自身でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also check the current time on this clock. Please check your device settings yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時計と案内を比べます。係員の方に私の端末を開けてもらうのでなく、自分で時刻の設定を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホテル時計と案内を比べ本人が端末設定を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll compare the clock with the information. Rather than asking a staff member to unlock my device, I'll review the time settings myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the hotel clock with the information and check your device settings yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 起きてから集合場所までのご準備にも、お時間を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also allow time to get ready and reach the meeting place after waking up.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 集合時刻ちょうどに起きる設定にはせず、着替えと移動の時間を入れます。場所も案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替えと移動時間を取り集合場所も確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't set it to wake me at the exact meeting time. I'll allow time to change clothes and travel there. I'll check the place in the information too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to allow time to change clothes and travel, and check the meeting place too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お部屋へ戻られたら、予定が保存されたかもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return to your room, please also check that the alarm has been saved.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存できたことを確かめます。前の設定は止めて、明日の予定に合うものだけ使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存を確認し旧設定を止め明日の予定に合う起床設定を使うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll make sure it has been saved. I'll turn off the old setting and use only the one that fits tomorrow's schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check it is saved, turn off the old setting, and use a wake-up alarm that fits tomorrow's plans. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、明日のご準備を整えてお休みください。それでは、おやすみなさいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please finish preparing for tomorrow and get some rest. Good night.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 靴に泥が付いているようですね。お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your shoes seem to have mud on them. Do you need help?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この後、電車で帰ります。泥を落としてから乗りたいのですが、どこで靴をきれいにしてよいか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散策後に電車へ乗る前に靴の泥を落とせる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going home by train after this. I'd like to remove the mud before boarding. Could you tell me where I can clean my shoes?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can remove the mud from your shoes after your walk and before taking the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの通路ではなく、あちらの手入れ用の台をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please use that cleaning stand over there, rather than this walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あの台へ移ります。人が通る所で靴をたたくと、泥が周りへ飛んでしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路で泥を飛ばさず指定の手入れ台へ移ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll move to that stand. If I knock my shoes where people walk, the mud will scatter around.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to the designated cleaning stand rather than scattering mud in the walkway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 台に靴用のブラシがあります。ほかの場所の道具と混ぜず、使った後は元へお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a shoe brush at the stand. Don't mix it with tools from other areas, and return it to its place after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 靴用のブラシを使います。かばんにはきれいな服もあるので、泥の付いた靴をそのまま中へ入れるのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 靴用ブラシを使い汚れた靴を清潔な服の入るかばんへ入れないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll use the shoe brush. My bag also has clean clothes in it, so I want to avoid putting the muddy shoes straight inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the shoe brush and not put dirty shoes in the bag with clean clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今履いている靴でお帰りになるのですね。手入れが終わったら、道具と使った場所をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You'll be going home in the shoes you are wearing now, then. When you're done cleaning, please check the tools and the area you used.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 靴の泥を落としました。履いて帰れます。使ったブラシも確認して、こちらの置き場所へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 泥を落とした靴で帰れ道具も元の位置へ返すと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've removed the mud from my shoes. I can wear them home. I'll check the brush I used too and return it to its place here.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you can go home wearing the cleaned shoes and will return the tool to its original place. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 台の周りに落とした泥は、こちらの紙で集めて、あの回収箱へ入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please gather the mud that fell around the stand with this paper and put it in that collection bin.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙で泥を集め、回収箱へ入れました。きれいな服とは一緒にせず、この靴を履いて帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙で泥を集め指定箱へ入れ清潔な服とは分け靴を履いて帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've gathered the mud with the paper and put it in the collection bin. I'll keep these shoes separate from the clean clothes and wear them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you gathered the mud with paper, put it in the designated bin, and will wear the shoes home, keeping them separate from clean clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、帰り道も足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking everything. Please watch your step on the way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 風鈴をご覧になっていますね。贈り物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're looking at wind chimes. Is it for a gift?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母国の姉に贈りたいです。絵が気に入りましたが、音をまだ聞いていないので、一度聞かせてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉への風鈴ギフトを絵だけで決めず見本の音を聞きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to give one to my older sister in my home country. I like the design, but I haven't heard the sound yet. Could I listen to it once?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to hear the sample wind chime rather than choosing your sister's gift only by its design. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの見本で、短くお聞きいただけます。お姉様はどこに飾られるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can listen briefly to this sample. Where does your sister plan to display it?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 寝室に置くかもしれません。姉は静かな部屋が好きなので、絵だけで選ぶ前に、音も考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 寝室に飾る可能性と姉が静かな環境を好むことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: She might put it in her bedroom. She likes a quiet room, so I want to consider the sound too before choosing it just for the design.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it may be displayed in a bedroom and that your sister likes a quiet environment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの見本の音をお聞きください。実際に鳴る回数は、置く場所の風などで変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please listen to this sample. How often it actually rings will depend on things like the wind where it is placed.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 音は好きですが、毎晩ずっと鳴る場所は避けたいです。姉には音が出る物だと先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音の好みと継続して鳴る場所を避けたい希望を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I like the sound, but I'd want to avoid a place where it rings all night, every night. I'll tell my sister beforehand that it makes a sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish liking the sound from wanting to avoid a place where it keeps ringing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 飾る場所は、お受取りになった方にも選んでいただくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: It would be good to let the recipient choose where to display it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓に決まっていると言わず、姉と相談します。風が当たらない所でも絵を楽しめるよう、この柄を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 飾る場所は姉と相談し風のない場所で絵も楽しめる柄を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll discuss it with my sister rather than saying it has to go by the window. I'd like this pattern so she can enjoy the design even somewhere out of the wind.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Discuss the display location with your sister and choose a pattern she can enjoy even in a place without wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この柄の一つでよろしいですか。持ち帰りの包みもご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like one with this pattern? We can also prepare wrapping for taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つお願いします。音を聞かせてもらえたので、贈る時に絵と音の両方を説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一個を指定し相手へ絵と音の両方を説明できると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: One, please. Now that you've let me hear it, I can explain both the design and the sound when I give it to her.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Specify one item and say that you can explain both the design and sound to the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、大切にお包みします。それでは、お姉様への贈り物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll wrap it carefully. Enjoy giving this gift to your sister.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方と作品についてお話しされていましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: You were discussing the artwork with your companion, weren't you?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ絵なのに、友人は楽しそう、私は寂しそうと感じました。どちらかが読み間違えたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と同じ絵の明るさの印象が違い読み間違いか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: Although it was the same painting, my friend thought it looked cheerful and I thought it looked lonely. Did one of us misread it?
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether either of you misread the same painting because you and your friend had different impressions of its mood. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、どの部分を見てそう感じたのか、ご自身で振り返ってみてはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Why not first reflect on which part you looked at that gave you that impression?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は端に一人で立つ人を見ました。友人は中央の明るい色を見ていたそうです。注目した所が違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は端の人物で友人は中央の色に注目したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked at the person standing alone at the edge. My friend says they were looking at the bright colors in the center. We focused on different parts.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you focused on the person at the edge while your friend focused on the colors in the center. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作品の説明も参考にできますが、お互いの感想を急いで一つにする必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can refer to the description of the artwork too, but you don't need to rush to make your impressions the same.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分が見た人と感じたことをメモします。友人の感想を否定するための説明を探すのではなく、違いを話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人を否定せず自分の注目部分と感想をメモして違いを話したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note down the person I looked at and how I felt. Rather than looking for an explanation to disprove my friend's impression, I want to discuss the differences.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to note your own focus and impressions and discuss the differences without rejecting your friend's view. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示室では声を抑え、詳しいお話は鑑賞を終えてからお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please keep your voices down in the exhibition room and save a detailed discussion for after viewing.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここでは短く伝えます。鑑賞後に落ち着いて話せる所を探し、友人が見た色のことも聞いてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 館内は声を抑え詳しい対話は鑑賞後に行うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep it brief here. After viewing, I'll find somewhere we can talk calmly and ask about the colors my friend saw too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide to keep your voices down inside and have a detailed discussion after viewing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もう一度ご覧になる時も、周りの方の鑑賞を妨げない位置でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you look again, please also stand somewhere that won't obstruct other visitors' viewing.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 脇から見直します。友人の説明を聞いた後、自分も中央の色を見て、感じ方がどう変わるか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 周囲を妨げず中央の色も見て感じ方の変化を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take another look from the side. After hearing my friend's explanation, I'll look at the colors in the center too and consider how my impression changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will look at the central colors too without obstructing others and consider how your impression changes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 違う見方も楽しめそうですね。それでは、お二人で静かにご鑑賞ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: It sounds like you can enjoy the different perspectives too. Please enjoy viewing quietly together.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日のご移動の予定をお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me your travel plans for today.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から、先に買物へ行って、それから親戚の家へ行くといいと言われました。その順でバスを教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から聞いた買物と親戚訪問の順でバス案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend told me it would be good to go shopping first and then visit my relatives' home. I'd like bus directions in that order.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for bus directions in the order your friend suggested: shopping, then visiting relatives. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 親戚の方とのお約束の時刻はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you arranged a time to meet your relatives?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昼に会う約束です。買物を長くすると間に合わないかもしれません。友人には昼の約束を話していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昼の訪問約束を友人へ伝えておらず買物先行は間に合わないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: We've agreed to meet at noon. If I spend too long shopping, I might not make it in time. I hadn't told my friend about the noon arrangement.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had not told your friend about your noon visit arrangement and might not arrive in time if you shop first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、約束を先に考えた順で、行きたい場所を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's organize the places you want to go in an order that puts your appointment first.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に親戚の家へ行き、会った後で買物にします。店を先にすると言われたからと、その順に合わせる必要はないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の約束を優先し訪問後に買物する順へ変更すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll visit my relatives' home first and shop after seeing them. I don't have to follow that order just because someone told me to go to the shops first.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to prioritize your own appointment and change the order to shopping after the visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 親戚の家へ行くための停留所は、お相手に確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you checked the bus stop for your relatives' home with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メモに名前があります。まずこの停留所への便を聞き、帰りの買物への移動はその後で相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 親戚が示した停留所メモを提示し最初の便から確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: The name is on this note. I'd like to ask about the service to this stop first, then discuss getting to the shops on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the note of the stop your relatives indicated and ask to check the first service first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最初の便からご案内します。乗る時刻と降りる停留所を、案内と照らしてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll guide you through the first service first. Please check your boarding time and the stop where you get off against the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に昼の訪問、後で買物という順で確認します。友人にも、自分の約束に合わせて順を変えたと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更した訪問順を案内と照合し友人へも予定変更を知らせると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check in the order of the noon visit first and shopping afterwards. I'll also tell my friend that I changed the order to fit my own appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the revised visit order against the guidance and tell your friend about the change too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで最初の便の案内をご覧ください。それでは、よいお出掛けを。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please look at the information for your first bus here. Have a good outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お味はいかがでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: How did you find the taste?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: とても軽い感じがして、うれしかったです。母国の言い方を考えながら話してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母語から考えた軽いという表現で食後の肯定的な感想を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: It felt very light, and I was pleased. I said it while thinking of the expression in my home language.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give positive feedback after the meal using the expression 'light' that you thought of in your native language. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 量が少なく感じられた、ということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you mean you felt the portion was small?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 量のことではありません。つゆの味が強すぎず、そばの香りを感じられた、ということを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 量の不足でなくつゆの強さとそばの香りの感じ方を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm not talking about the amount. I mean the broth's flavor wasn't too strong and I could appreciate the aroma of the soba.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Rephrase it as the broth's strength and soba's aroma, rather than an insufficient portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 味についてのお話なのですね。言い直してくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you mean the flavor. Thank you for rephrasing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。自分にはやさしい味に感じました。友人にもすすめたいですが、私の感じたこととして話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人にはやさしい味で友人への紹介も自分の感想として伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. To me it tasted mild. I'd like to recommend it to my friend too, but I'll describe it as my own impression.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say it tasted mild to you and you will recommend it to your friend as your own impression. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご一緒の方も、同じものを召し上がりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did the person with you have the same dish?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人は別の品です。その人の感想まで一緒にせず、私が食べたこちらのそばのことを話しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人は別の料理で本人が食べたそばだけの感想と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend had a different dish. I'm not including their impression; I'm talking only about this soba that I ate.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend had a different dish and you are commenting only on the soba you ate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご感想を伺えてうれしいです。ほかにお尋ねはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'm glad to hear your feedback. Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はありません。量が足りないという不満ではなく、おいしくいただけたお礼でした。ごちそうさまでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足への不満でなくおいしく食べた礼を伝え食事を終える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not today. I wasn't complaining that the portion was insufficient; I was thanking you for a delicious meal. Thank you for the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: End the meal by thanking them for a meal you enjoyed, rather than complaining about an insufficient portion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらこそ、ご感想をありがとうございました。それでは、またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for sharing your impressions. We hope to see you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 片付けの報告か。今の担当はどこまで終わった。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Reporting on the cleanup? How much of your assigned work is done?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の担当の片付けを終えました。この後は帰るつもりで、退場の報告に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 担当の片付けを完了し退場を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've finished my assigned cleanup. I was planning to go home now, so I've come to report that I'm leaving the site.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your assigned cleanup is complete and you are leaving the site. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は新人への案内の当番も頼んでいた。そちらは済んでいるか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: I also asked you to guide the new worker today. Is that done?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。片付けが終わったことで、今日の役割も全部終わったと思っていました。案内する内容を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新人案内が未実施で残る当番内容を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. Because the cleanup was done, I thought all my duties for today were finished. Please let me check what guidance I'm supposed to give.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the new-worker guidance has not been done and you want to confirm the remaining duty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新人が来たら、まず私の所へ連れてきてほしい。作業の指導を全部任せるという意味ではない。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: When the new worker arrives, bring them to me first. I didn't mean that you were responsible for teaching them all the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。私だけで作業を教えるのではなく、到着した人を監督の所へ案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新人を監督へつなぐ役割で本人が全作業指導をするのでないと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Rather than teaching the work by myself, I'll guide the person who arrives to the supervisor.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Repeat that your role is to connect the new worker with the supervisor, rather than personally teaching all the work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待つ場所は、指示した入口の受付だ。ほかの用事と重なりそうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wait at the entrance reception desk I instructed you to use. Does that look likely to overlap with any other commitments?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家へ帰る時間が少し変わりますが、待てます。自分で別の人へ当番を押し付けず、予定が変わった時はこちらへ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指示受付で待ち予定変更時は監督へ相談し独断で当番を他人へ移さないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: It will change the time I get home a little, but I can wait. I won't push the duty onto someone else on my own. If my plans change, I'll consult you here.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at the specified reception desk, consult the supervisor if plans change, and not transfer the duty to someone else on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 到着が遅れる場合は、私が確認する。案内後にも一度報告してくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: If their arrival is delayed, I'll check on it. Report to me once more after guiding them too.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内後に報告します。片付けの完了と、残る案内当番を分けて確認できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内後の報告を了承し片付け完了と残担当を区別して確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll report after guiding them. I've now checked the completed cleanup and the remaining guidance duty separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to report after guiding the new worker and confirm the completed cleanup separately from the remaining duty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付で待つことを確認した。よろしく頼む。案内後に報告してくれ。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we've confirmed you'll wait at reception. I'm counting on you. Report after guiding them. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お客様の窓口番号をお呼びしました。いま機械をご利用中ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: We've called your counter number. Are you using the machine at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。待っている間にATMを使い始めました。まだ終わっていないので、そのまま窓口へ移ってよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口番号の呼出しを受けたがATMが未完了と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I started using the ATM while waiting. I'm not finished yet, so I'm unsure whether I should go straight to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your counter number was called but you have not finished at the ATM. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 機械を途中で離れず、いま表示されている内容をご自身で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't leave the machine partway through. Please check what is currently displayed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今は内容を確認する画面です。呼ばれたからと、何も見ずに次の操作を押すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 内容確認画面で急いで未確認のまま操作を進めないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's on the screen for checking the details now. I won't press the next button without looking just because I've been called.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are on the details-confirmation screen and will not hurry on without checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口の順番については、こちらで確認します。機械の状態を終えた後にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check about your turn at the counter. Please tell us after you have finished at the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。画面の案内を読んで、自分の操作を終えてから声を掛けます。窓口の番号も手元に持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 機械の案内を読み操作を終えてから職員へ知らせ番号も保持すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll read the screen instructions and finish my operation before calling you. I have my counter number with me too.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will read the machine instructions, finish the operation, then notify the staff, while keeping your number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お手続きは、ご自身で内容を確認しながら進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please proceed while checking the details of your transaction yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 操作を終えました。カードと明細を受け取ったので、機械の前から離れる準備ができました。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 操作完了後にカードと明細を受け取ったと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've finished. I've collected my card and statement, so I'm ready to leave the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you finished the operation and collected your card and statement. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。窓口の受付の扱いを確認しますので、番号をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. We'll check how to handle your counter reception, so please show me your number.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらの番号です。今すぐ相談が始まると決めず、案内された場所で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付番号を示し窓口開始を決めつけず職員の案内を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here is my number. I won't assume my consultation will start immediately; I'll wait where I'm directed.
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your reception number and say you will await the staff's directions without assuming the counter consultation will start immediately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、受付の順番を確認してご案内します。それでは、こちらで少しお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-020-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check the reception order and guide you. Please wait here for a moment. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族のご乗車について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: How can I help with your family member's train journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母が初めて一人で列車に乗ります。私は全部代わりに答えていましたが、母が何を心配しているか聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めて単独乗車する母の心配を聞かず代答していたと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother is taking a train alone for the first time. I've been answering everything for her, but I haven't asked what she's worried about.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you answered for your mother without asking her concerns about her first solo train journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずご本人のお話を伺えます。付き添いの方は、どこまでご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can listen to her directly first. How far will you be accompanying her?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はここで見送ります。母には、分からない時に自分で尋ねたいのか、一緒に案内を聞きたいのか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は見送りのみで本人が望む案内方法を先に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm just seeing her off here. I'll ask my mother whether she wants to ask questions herself when she's unsure or hear the guidance together with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are only seeing her off and will first ask how she herself would like to receive guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望に合わせてご案内します。今、特に知りたい点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll guide her in the way she prefers. Is there anything in particular she wants to know now?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母は降りる駅を見落とさないか心配しています。切符を持つことより、車内で何を確かめるか聞きたいそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 降車駅の見落としが心配で車内確認方法を尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My mother is worried she might miss the station where she gets off. She says she wants to ask what to check on the train, rather than about holding her ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that she is worried about missing her stop and wants to ask how to check it on the train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車内の表示や案内を確認する方法をご説明できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain how to check the displays and information on the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。私が母の携帯を持ったままにせず、連絡できる状態で渡します。切符も本人に確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯と切符を本人へ渡して確認してもらうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I won't keep holding my mother's phone; I'll give it to her ready for her to use to stay in contact. I'll have her check her ticket too.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will give her the phone and ticket and have her check them herself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明の後、ご本人に分かった点をお話しいただきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: After the explanation, let's ask her to tell us what she understood.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私だけが理解して終わらせません。母の希望を聞き、必要なことだけ補います。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 付き添いだけの理解で終えず本人の説明を聞いて補うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. We won't finish with only me understanding. I'll listen to my mother's wishes and add only what is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will not finish with only the companion understanding, but will listen to her explanation and add what is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人と一緒に案内を確認しましょう。それでは、よいご旅行になりますように。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's check the guidance together with her. We wish her a good trip. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 体調の記録をお持ちですね。補足したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a record of your health. Is there anything you'd like to add?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「忙しい」とだけ書きました。でも、仕事の予定と体の感じを分けて伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 忙しいの一語でなく勤務と体調を分けて説明したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only wrote 'busy.' But I'd like to explain my work schedule and how my body feels separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to explain your work and physical condition separately, rather than using only the word 'busy.' Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最近の勤務は、どのように変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: How has your work schedule changed recently?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週から、帰る時刻が二時間ほど遅くなりました。毎日の勤務時刻はこのメモにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 先週から帰宅前の退勤が二時間遅く勤務メモがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Since last week, I've been leaving about two hours later. My daily working hours are on this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that since last week you have finished work about two hours later before going home and have a work-hours note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 体の変化も、分かる範囲で診療担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell the clinician about any physical changes, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 帰宅後に頭が重く感じる日があります。忙しさだけが原因と決めたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰宅後の頭の重さはあるが原因を忙しさと断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: On some days, my head feels heavy after I get home. I haven't concluded that being busy is the only cause.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your head sometimes feels heavy after getting home, but you are not concluding that being busy is the cause. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その感じが出た日や、休みの日の様子も記録されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you also recorded the days when that feeling occurred and how you were on days off?

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出た日は丸を付けています。休みの日は記録していないので、仕事の日だけの症状だとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 症状日の印はあるが休日未記録で仕事日に限定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've circled the days when it occurred. I haven't recorded days off, so I can't say it happens only on workdays.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that symptom days are marked, but days off are unrecorded, so you cannot limit the symptoms to workdays. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 勤務の記録と症状の記録を、それぞれ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show your work records and symptom records separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。書いていない日は症状なしとせず、分からないと伝えます。仕事の相談ではなく体の変化を診てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未記録を症状なしとせず体の診察用に二記録を示すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't treat an unrecorded day as a day without symptoms; I'll say I don't know. I want my physical changes examined, rather than work-related counseling.
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the two records for a physical examination without treating unrecorded days as symptom-free. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二つの記録を担当へお渡しください。それでは、診察のご案内をお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-021-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give both records to the person in charge. Then wait for instructions for your consultation. Take care.
